d: You as a GIS Installation and commissioning Team Lead will be part of Hitachi Energy business based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. A Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) Nurse is a highly skilled healthcare professional dedicated to providing specialized, life-saving care to critically ill infants, children, and adolescents. Working in a fast-paced and high-acuity environment, PICU nurses monitor complex conditions, operate advanced life-support equipment, and collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver comprehensive and compassionate care.
q: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the relevant regulatory body (e.g., DOH/DHA/MOH)
Minimum of 2-3 years of recent experience in a Pediatric Intensive Care Unit or critical care setting
r: li

li

li
